name: Tower media NFS health and repair
description: EKSPORTERT UTEN HEMMELIGHETER. Erstatt REDACTED_HASS_TOKEN i Notify-noden etter import. SSH-nøkkel sti er bevart; selve nøkkelen ligger i n8n-containeren (/home/node/.n8n/ssh/), ikke her. Se docs/tower-media-nfs-health-repair.md.

parameters.command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i /home/node/.n8n/ssh/tower_media_ed25519 root@10.0.0.120 && ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i /home/node/.n8n/ssh/tower_media_ed25519 root@10.0.0.103

parameters.jsCode: const output = String($json.stdout ?? $json.error?.message ?? ''); const failed = Number($json.exitCode ?? 0) !== 0 || Boolean($json.error); return (failed || output.includes('repaired;')) ? items : [];

nodes.name: Notify iPhone: Tower media repaired
nodes.notes: Home Assistant sender videre til telefonen. Punktum-format (/api/notify/...) gir 404.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ title: (Number(.exitCode ?? 0) !== 0 || .error) ? 'Tower media NFS: reparasjon feilet' : 'Tower media NFS reparert', message: String(.stdout ?? .error?.message ?? 'Se n8n-kjøringen for detaljer') }) }}
